mapper.select: SELECT s.seller_sku, s.sku_id FROM shop_product_sku s INNER JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.shop_product_id WHERE p.shop_id = #{shopId} AND s.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND s.seller_sku IN #{sellerSku}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_product_sku (shop_product_id, seller_sku, quantity, price, currency) VALUES (#{shopProductId}, #{sellerSku}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{currency}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = COALESCE(new.quantity, shop_product_sku.quantity), price = COALESCE(new.price, shop_product_sku.price), currency = COALESCE(new.currency, shop_product_sku.currency)
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.seller_sku FROM shop_product_sku s INNER JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.shop_product_id WHERE p.shop_id = #{shopId} AND s.sku_id IS NULL
